# CANDIDATE: VIX_FLOOR_BEARISH_ENTRY_FILTER

**Filed:** 2026-08-24  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** quality_gate  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Requiring a minimum VIX level (e.g., VIX >= 15) at bearish entry improves edge capture on J's PUT winner days by filtering out low-VIX environments where bearish moves tend to fail. The hypothesis is based on observed VIX behavior on J's anchor days: 4/29 (VIX ~18), 5/01 (VIX ~16), 5/04 (VIX ~22) all exceeded 15, while loser days often had lower or flat VIX.

## Mechanism

Add a pre-entry quality gate that checks the real-time VIX value (from the same data feed used for SPY) and only allows BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON entries when VIX >= 15. The gate is placed after the existing structural triggers (level rejection, ribbon flip, confluence) but before entry execution. No changes to exit logic or position sizing.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper ~= 14% headline P&L (per risk-rules.md position sizing).
2. **Sample bias:** Sample size would be the full 16-month OPRA dataset (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18). Selection method is deterministic based on VIX threshold; overfit risk exists if the threshold is tuned to J's anchor days without out-of-sample validation.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not yet performed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real OPRA fill validation on top 3 J days not yet performed).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: potential whipsaw in low-VIX bearish breakdowns that reverse quickly; max drawdown scenario if gate filters out too many trades causing equity curve stagnation; blow-up scenario if VIX spike leads to delayed entries and large adverse moves.
6. **Concentration:** Unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to compute top-5 days contribution to P&L.

May overlap with BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON's existing VIX confirmation rule (VIX rising or >20) but proposes a simpler static floor. No known duplication in leaderboard.
